uid.description: The unique ID of the user.

verified.description: Whether the user is a verified student.

createdAt.description: When the user account was created.

MarketplaceItem.title: MarketplaceItem
MarketplaceItem.description: An item listed for sale or trade in the marketplace.

id.description: The unique ID of the item.

description.description: A detailed description of the item.

category.description: The category of the item (e.g., Books, Electronics).

location.description: The campus location where the item is available.

image.description: The URL of the item's image.

status.description: The current status of the item.

trending.description: Whether the item is currently trending.

views.description: The number of views the item has received.

interest.description: The number of users who have expressed interest.

LostFoundItem.title: LostFoundItem
LostFoundItem.description: An item reported as lost or found on campus.

id.description: The unique ID of the report.

type.description: Whether the item is lost or found.

description.description: A description of the item and where it was lost/found.

location.description: The campus location where the item was lost/found.

image.description: An optional image of the item.

reporterId.description: The UID of the person reporting the item.

status.description: The current status of the report.

Meetup.title: Meetup
Meetup.description: A scheduled meetup for an item exchange.

id.description: The unique ID of the meetup.

itemId.description: The ID of the item being exchanged.

itemName.description: The name of the item being exchanged.

location.description: The campus location for the meetup.

time.description: The scheduled time for the meetup.

status.description: The current status of the meetup.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A chat conversation between two users.

id.description: The unique ID of the conversation.

participants.description: Array of user UIDs in the conversation.

participantNames.description: Map of UID to display name for quick access.

lastMessage.description: The content of the last message sent.

updatedAt.description: When the conversation was last updated.

itemId.description: Optional item ID this chat is about.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A single message in a conversation.

id.description: The unique ID of the message.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation this message belongs to.

/lostfound/{reportId}.description: The collection of lost and found reports.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Sub-collection of messages within a conversation.
